jobs.description:
Our customer, an innovative international organization in Leuven, is looking for an Administrative / Paralegal Officer to strengthen its team on a temporary basis. In this role, you will support business operations by managing contracts, quotations and purchase orders while working closely with both internal and external stakeholders.
 

Expectied tasks: 
 

As an Administrative / Paralegal Officer, you will play a key role in ensuring smooth administrative and contractual processes.
 

Your responsibilities include:
 

 
• Managing business contracts, including initiating approval workflows and coordinating electronic signatures.
 
• Drafting and processing business quotations while helping to standardize and optimize procedures.
 
• Reviewing purchase orders for completeness, consistency and accuracy before processing them.
 
• Communicating proactively with internal and external stakeholders regarding contract and order status.
 
• Building expertise in the business area you support, including customer requirements, contractual frameworks and quotation processes.
 
• Ensuring administrative accuracy and maintaining high-quality documentation. 

Your profile
 

 
• You have 3 to 5 years of experience in a medium to large-sized company, preferably within a complex business environment.
 
• You already gained initial experience in sales contract management, paralegal support, or a similar role.
 
• You are highly organized and able to manage priorities effectively.
 
• You work accurately and consistently deliver quality results.
 
• You thrive in a dynamic environment and adapt easily to changing processes.
 
• You can handle tight deadlines and a fast-paced workload.
 
• You are proficient with digital tools such as Microsoft Office, CRM systems, and document management platforms.
 
• You have excellent communication skills.
 
• You are fluent in English. Knowledge of Dutch is considered a strong asset.

As Warehouse Operator, you will execute in an accurate manner tasks concerning both the physical handling and administration aspect of goods that are received, stocked, delivered to internal customers and shipped to external contacts.

The assignment

• Make sure that goods are stored and registered in the appropriate location
• Stock counts
• Check stock of standard goods in the cleanroom and ensure sufficient and timely supply within shelf life and register accordingly
• Deliver goods to cleanroom upon request of internal customers and register accordingly
• Receive goods from internal customers, pack, label and ship to external location taking into account applicable legislation

• You work efficiently, accurately and neatly and have an eye for safety.
• You are energetic, not afraid of physical work and have a great sense of responsibility.
• Your team spirit guarantees a flexible working arrangement.
• You are fluent in Dutch and have a good knowledge of English.
• A certificate for operation of an electric stacker and forklift driving license is a plus.
• You preferably have several years of experience in administrative processing, experience with SAP is a plus.

We're looking for a Logistics Coordinator. 

In this role you will be responsible for handling laboratory supplies, study materials, medical devices and drug products, used in clinical trials.

Tasks:

• Manage returned materials and maintain inventory records from clinical sites
• Coordinate logistics activities for clinical studies
• Support purchasing activities when required
• Ensure compliance with company procedures and regulatory requirements
• Support the daily operations of the Central Laboratory supply team

A strong knowledge (written and spoken) in English is required, knowledge in another language is a big asset. Logistics tasks such as shipping, calling, mailing, checking in on stock, are interesting to you. A detail and client oriented mentality is needed. You ensure a day to day fluency in logistics and supply chain.

One of your main tasks will be to investigate complaints, deviations, out-of-specifications (OOS) and non-conformities, draft a report on these and propose corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

You will take on a part of the batch release activities of the medicines and other medical products produced on site. Additionally, you will monitor compliance to the internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and GMP (flows and zoning included) in production and the laboratory.

More specific: 

• Investigation and drafting of report for deviations; OOS; complaints and non-conformitiesMonitor compliance on internal standard operating procedures (SOP’s) and GMP in production and laboratory area
• Final batch release - including review of batch records (1-2h per day)
• GMP/GDP/Pharmacovigilance training of QC and production operators; warehouse workers and drivers.
• Writing of the yearly PQR (Product Quality Review)
• Review of QC and GMP procedures
• Involvement in GMP validation and qualification activities (equipment and processes in production and laboratory area) and other GMP projects
• Management of CAPA’s related to GMP activities
• Management of change controls related to GMP activities
• Support during (preparation of) audits on site
• Perform internal audits at other sites and suppliers

• You have a master degree in Industrial pharmacy
• You have at least 1 or 3 year experience in a GMP environment.
• You are a teamplayer, dynamic and have very good communication skills.
• Your mothertongue is Dutch and are fluent in English and French

jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany
• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card
• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.
